title: 2023 Donruss Football Press Proof #59 Trayveon Williams Cincinnati Bengals Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Trayveon Williams 2023 Donruss Football trading card is a must-have for any Cincinnati Bengals fan. The card features Williams in his Bengals uniform and is part of the base set, with a card number of 59. It is a standard size card and is also a Press Proof parallel/variety.

The card is not autographed and is ungraded. It is not in its original packaging or professionally graded, but it is in excellent condition. As a sports trading card collector, this Trayveon Williams card is a great addition to any collection.
